items.title: Check Out 46 Seconds Of New Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gameplay (And A Pink Chocobo)
items.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation aims to be the biggest chapter in the remake trilogy, not only in the number of reg

content.v: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation aims to be the biggest chapter in the remake trilogy, not only in the number of regions players can explore, but also in verticality. Square Enix had previously shown off how the game's cast will be able to skydive into new locations on the world map, but for a taste of just how much verticality the game will have in certain areas, you can check out this new slice of gameplay set in the Midgar region, which features Cloud exploring a massive chasm underneath the city--and atop a pink chocobo, too.

While that's a lot of empty space to fly through, it's still impressive just how much of it there is. Of course, this is only one part of the game, and there's no guarantee every region will have caverns this massive. But considering how Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth greatly expanded on the environments of Final Fantasy 7 Remake with its open-world design, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is expected to raise the bar by increasing the size of the world around Cloud and the rest of the gang. Revelation will also introduce Cid's iconic airship, the Highwind, which will serve as the gang's base of operations, and unfortunately, Chadley is there too.
All that "planetary-scale" content will take up a lot of space on your PC or console, with game director Naoki Hamaguchi estimating the game will be "around" 200GB.

One of the big games to look forward to next year, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch on April 8, 2027. It's estimated that a complete playthrough could take as long as 100 hours--something Hamaguchi had done 46 times already when last we spoke to him--and two post-launch expansions starring Vincent Valentine and Sephiroth will follow in the game's wake.

"My time with the final chapter of the Final Fantasy 7 remake trilogy clearly shows that the team at Square Enix has plenty of story left to tell. We’ll just have to wait until April for the rest of the Revelation(s)," Jason Fanelli wrote after going hands-on with Final Fantasy 7 Revelation earlier this month.

items.title: Square Enix 资深人士表示，未来的开发人员需要“掌握人工智能的使用”，但人性化仍然至关重要
items.summary: "Humans need to be involved in the initial step of turning zero into one."

content.v: AI's a touchy subject in the development industry, but in other areas it's a lot less controversial—take Japan, for instance, which is embracing the technology a lot more than audiences in the West are. That's not to say there isn't any push back at all , mind.

Still, an example of how there's more of a positive spin on it overseas comes courtesy of a Famitsu interview (translated here by Automaton ) where seasoned JRPG devs from Square Enix seem broadly positive on the tech—and are repeating some oft-heard talking points that I, at least, am personally very bored of, even if I wouldn't dismiss them out of hand.

Hiromichi Tanaka, who worked on many Final Fantasy games during his tenure (which ended in 2012), says that the creations of the future "will definitely come down to how well people can master the use of AI." Yoshinori Kitase (also a veteran, and current producer on Final Fantasy 7: Revelation) concurs, saying: "major game companies will need to rethink their development methods to avoid being swept away by this wave."

Kitase points out that we've already had an increased wave of indie games from the popularisation of accessible game engines, and "when you add support from new tools and technologies on top of that, even people with limited experience can more easily make games."

We have seen a touch of that in all of these decompiled games , but there's also the fact that people with limited experience are also able to just up and steal ideas easier, too. And I'm not talking about a corporate aversion to piracy, here. The developers of Moonlighter recently had to yank their ReVamp demo from Steam because it was getting cloned—that's an indie dev having its hard work copy-pasted.

Kitase does at least acknowledge that people don't tend to find purely AI-generated or cloned slop tasteful, though: "Humans need to be involved in the initial step of turning zero into one," a turn of phrase he uses to describe the human creative spark and original ideas. "That will never change. The next generation of creators absolutely needs the ability to turn zero into one."

Tanaka adds that this'll turn the industry into a "competition of ideas". Which is a nice fantasy on paper, though I'm not entirely sure it's panning out that way in practice—as mentioned above, indie developers, already on rocky ground in an unkind industry where discoverability is a nightmare, are at risk of either having their games cloned or drowned in a sea of AI slop .

items.title: Edge 杂志前往 Rockstar 观看 GTA 6，并将于本周四（10 月 29 日）向您详细介绍该游戏的全部内容
items.summary: I bet you can steal cars.

content.v: We are just three weeks out from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, which you can tell because it has cleared the release calendar around it like the Chicxulub crater. Ahead of the big day, our friends at Edge magazine visited Rockstar's Edinburgh development HQ to chat with the studio's leaders and put their eyes on GTA 6 in action . That's right folks, it's officially happening. This thing is officially almost a videogame you can play.

The result? The 16-page cover story coming in Edge #430, on sale October 29 . They've really been cooking over there, bringing us a bunch of exclusive new imagery, interviews with Rockstar head honchos, and a special gatefold cover with artwork of Jason and Lucia, about whom I already have very strong feelings.
If you're in the UK, you're in luck, because you can pick up the GTA 6 special edition free, plus 13 issues of Edge at 38% off the price you'd pay at the newsstand if you subscribe at this link .
Outside the UK? Don't fret, because new subs will get a free digital edition of the GTA 6 special issue if you subscribe here .
And wherever you are, the full 16-page feature will drop here for everyone to read for free on October 29, coinciding with the release of the magazine.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/B3H6djPN6P9U6xEN77WqD4-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Zp3pTKPB4V7cmYWLhAaxD4-1920-80.png

It's lavish, lovely, and in-depth—so all very Edge, and if you're one of the approximately 8 billion people who are desperate to know more about the most-anticipated game in Rockstar's history (or, well, just history in general, probably), you're gonna want to feast your eyes on it.

items.summary: Medium rare. Are you a fan of that genre ? You know, the one that hasn’t quite settled on its name yet: myster

content.v: Medium rare.

Are you a fan of that genre ? You know, the one that hasn’t quite settled on its name yet: mystery games… discovery games… information games . We’re talking The Case of the Golden Idol , The Roottrees Are Dead , Her Story , Blue Prince , TR-49 , Type Help … If you are, you too will be able to rattle off quite a few titles by now – but not as many as you’d like. So you’ll be intrigued to know that The Séance of Blake Manor has made its way onto Switch 2.

On the face of it, Blake Manor might be right up your alley, presenting as it does a curious investigator, a sprawling and intricate scenario for you to examine, and masses of information to be managed and interconnected. However, its approach is wonderfully distinctive and characterful, picking which aspects of the genre to lean into.

items.title: 花30多万买奔驰 提车当天就卡顿！4S店要拆车却遭拒
items.summary: 快科技10月27日消息，据报道，近期，郭先生在义乌一家奔驰4S店购入了一台新车，裸车价格超30万元，打算买来送给女儿使用。

content.v: 快科技10月27日消息，据报道，近期，郭先生在义乌一家奔驰4S店购入了一台新车，裸车价格超30万元，打算买来送给女儿使用。
可车辆刚提出来，在去往加油站的途中，车子就出现明显的换挡卡顿现象，行驶过程中会产生类似急刹车的顿挫感，驾驶体验大打折扣，还有一定的安全隐患。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272300158904.png
察觉到异常之后，郭先生立刻将车辆送回4S店进行处理。初期4S店先升级了软件，又安排工作人员上路测试，但问题还是没有解决。
后面，4S店又通知郭先生要拆车检查，但这个方案郭先生肯定是不同意的。
在郭先生看来，这是一台刚刚交付的全新车辆，还没有正常使用，就要被拆解检修，相当于新车直接被“大卸八块”，心理上完全难以接受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272300223385.png
他也担心如果最终不符合退换条件，这期间的损失该怎么算。
4S店方面则表示，目前通过后台读取的数据，尚且无法锁定故障点，拆解检查是技术层面排查问题的必要手段。
门店也承诺，如果拆解之后确认故障情况满足三包退换车标准，愿意履行相应的售后义务，但一切结论都要以拆解之后的检测结果为准。目前车辆的具体问题尚未查明，双方仍在沟通中。

items.title: 《仙剑4重制版》主角形象引争议：幼态网红脸审美？
items.summary: 《仙剑奇侠传四 重制版》官宣12月5日公布发售日，然而因角色建模更新再度引发玩家热议

content.v: 《仙剑奇侠传四 重制版》官宣12月5日公布发售日，然而因角色建模更新再度引发玩家热议。尽管官方采用虚幻引擎5进行了全面视觉升级，但玩家反馈呈现明显两极分化，云天河、韩菱纱等核心角色的外观改动均遭到不同程度批评。
原作中云天河是在青鸾峰长大的“野人”，带有粗粝、纯粹的少年野性。但重制版预告中的云天河被不少玩家批评“幼态”过重，另有玩家指出其“面部缺乏特点，少了点原版的灵动劲儿”。

韩菱纱的批评集中在服装和脸型。有玩家直接对服装配色提出质疑：“菱纱的脸挺好看的，但是为什么衣服也选这种又深又丑的紫色？”。原作韩菱纱的劲装以红、蓝等鲜明色调为主，重制版偏深的紫色被认为偏离了角色原本的视觉印象。脸型方面，重制版将她的脸做得更圆润，有玩家形容为“多了点婴儿肥”，虽然“更漂亮了”，但“少了点俏皮”，与原作机敏狡黠的气质产生了距离。发型也从双马尾改为单侧编发，同样被部分玩家视为“网红化”的改动。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272245597017.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272246009402.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272246011081.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272244393997.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272244447257.png
这些批评的共同指向，并非单纯反对“变好看”，而是认为高清化在提升细节的同时，磨掉了原版角色身上那些不精致却有辨识度的特质。原版《仙剑四》受限于2007年的技术，建模棱角分明，但角色的气质反而因此显得鲜明——云天河的野、韩菱纱的灵、柳梦璃的清冷，都建立在一种“不完美但准确”的视觉语言之上。重制版用UE5将这些角色推向更光滑、更符合当代审美的方向，却让一部分老玩家感到“认不出是谁”。

items.title: 《刺客信条黑旗RE》最终大更新上线！超多内容爽玩
items.summary: 《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置》是育碧对2013年经典之作《刺客信条4：黑旗》的一次现代重制，游戏已于7月9日正式发售，支持中配。

content.v: 《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置》是育碧对2013年经典之作《刺客信条4：黑旗》的一次现代重制，游戏已于7月9日正式发售，支持中配。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247188163.png
据PushSquare报道，育碧现已推出《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置》1.0.8版本补丁。官方确认，这是本作上线之后最后一次大型内容更新，未来只会推出BUG修复、体验优化类小补丁。
具体更新内容如下：
更新大小
Xbox Series X|S: 15.5 GB
PlayStation®5: 4.5 GB
PC: 4.3 GB
Steam: 2.1 GB
更新亮点
新游戏+
再度扬帆（一次、又一次、又一次、又一次、又一次）
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/origin_202610272247408746.gif
一次次重返加勒比海，开启新的探索。“新游戏+”终于来了！在保留已有收获的同时，再次踏上爱德华·肯威的传奇旅程，探索辽阔海域，重新集结你的船员！
可继承的内容
爱德华的所有工具、升级、已解锁武器及饰品。
寒鸦号的所有升级、已解锁的指挥官能力及宠物。
指挥官不会直接出现在船上，需要重新招募。
物品栏中的所有金钱、材料及交易品。
新游戏+将引入一种新货币。
任务相关物品将被移除。
所有已解锁的可自定义服装及其自定义选项。
藏身处的建设进度、增益效果及艺术收藏。
肯威的舰队中的所有船只。
不过，由于地图迷雾将会重置，你需要重新攻占各座要塞。
百科条目，包括已获取及已完成的各张藏宝图。
从商店购买的物品。
每开启一次新游戏+，海域都会变得更加危险。精英士兵更常出现，最高等级的船只也会开始在海上巡逻。每次重启旅程，难度都会提升。你最多可以开启五次新游戏+，推进至“新游戏+++++”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247512598.jpg
我们还为新游戏+加入了一种专属货币。你可以通过完成挑战，以及搜刮此前已开启过的宝箱来积累这种货币，也可以在杂货店将银圆兑换为葡萄牙元。使用葡萄牙元，你可以购买新游戏+专属的新服装与物品。原本可用银圆购买的物品不受影响，仍可在原来的商人处以相同价格购买。
噩梦难度
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247596302.jpg
没有重来的机会，也没有手下留情。噩梦难度将让《黑旗 记忆重置》化为一场残酷的生存之战，每次交锋都可能成为你的最后一战。敌人的反应更快，攻击更加致命，片刻犹豫也可能让你付出代价。加勒比海依旧美丽，但在海浪之下、地平线之外，死亡正等待着毫无准备的冒险者。
陆上战斗
敌人造成的伤害提高至原来的1.8倍。
招架的判定时间窗口缩短。
敌人攻击时不再出现白色闪光提示。
远程敌人的射击频率提高。
关闭防止被一击击杀的保护机制。
这是影响最显著的变化：即使玩家仍有大量生命值，游戏也不会再阻止其被瞬间击杀。请务必格外小心子弹与爆炸物。
潜行

items.title: Steam Next Fest Was Flooded With Slop. These 50 Demos Cut Through The Noise
items.summary: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess . What was once a fun week-long fe

content.v: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess . What was once a fun week-long festival of early game demos has become a dumping ground for vibe-coded AI slop, making it increasingly hard to find and wishlist good games. And if you weren't bothered by playing a game demo that was hastily cobbled together, the sheer volume--around 7,100 game demos were available this time--of what was on offer made Next Fest a nightmare to navigate. So what's a person to do when Valve's own storefront lacked the tools to separate the wheat from the chaff? Be patient, and look at the general consensus; that's what.

While Next Fest is over, many of those games' demos are still readily available to download and play. The Top 50 Next Fest demos for October 2026 span a wide variety of genres and themes, and the list shows a few trends. Social, co-op, and friendslop games rose to the top, as people couldn't get enough of multiplayer chaos in party games like Worst Class Ever, while Fart Together offered physics-driven goofiness and intestinal turbulence.

Niche management and shopkeeper sims also attracted players, with Questing Goose Studio's Probably Stolen and Victorian-gothic gem-cutting sim Abyssal Lapidary proving popular. Anyone looking for low-effort experiences will likely enjoy desktop companion games like Character House, and anticipated sequels like ArcheAge Chronicles drew big player numbers. One thing to note is that some of these games--like Teach My Little Sister How To Drive --do have AI disclosures attached, which you can filter for .

The list below should be a solid starting point for checking out game demos that drew massive buzz, but waiting a week to see what's worth playing based on popularity alone isn't exactly ideal. Valve hasn't said anything about how the third and final Next Fest of the year was a mess, despite the public outcry, even though the number of games for this instance of the event almost doubled compared with the June 2026 edition. If that trend continues, next year's Next Fest in February could be even more difficult to explore.

Beyond Next Fest, Steam has also confirmed the dates for several upcoming sales and themed promotions for the rest of 2026 and the first half of 2027. The Steam Winter Sale 2026 will run from December 17 – January 4, 2027, and right now, you can stock up on horror games through Steam Scream V Fest.
Steam Next Fest October 2026: The Most-Played Demos
Ordered by number of unique players during the week-long event.

content.v: 此前因给《影之刃零》打出3星（M站折算60分）而陷入争议的Eurogamer编辑Emma Kent再次发文，披露了她在评测这款游戏时遇到的一些“非常奇怪的情况”。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
Emma Kent指出，在评测过程中有两个主要因素影响了她的体验。
首先，S-Game官方对评测者提出了严格的叙事限制，要求他们不要讨论游戏中的很大一部分剧情，甚至明确表示不能剧透序章的过场动画。这导致她无法在评测中充分赞扬游戏后期一些很酷的叙事手法，她对此感到“非常遗憾”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270957231084.jpg

items.title: Nvidia 可能尚未停产 RTX 5090，但一位 AIB 合作伙伴表示，它无法获得制造该卡所需的零件
items.summary: And RTX 5090s weren't cheap before.

content.v: Nvidia's RTX 5090 has been a subject of much speculation recently, as it was rumoured to be discontinued last month when it vanished from the company's official marketplace, only for Nvidia to confirm it wasn't discontinued . The plot has thickened, though, as AIB partners—the companies actually designing and manufacturing RTX 50 series graphics cards—suggest even they can't get their hands on the parts required to make the card.

This is according to an Nvidia AIB partner who spoke to YouTuber Der8auer . They say, "No, Nvidia did not inform us that RTX 5090 is EOL. But currently we cannot purchase GB202 [the GPU] together with 32 GB GDDR7 as [a] complete set, and we also don't know if ordering will be possible again in the future."
The unnamed board partner clarifies that in previous shortages, they could place backorders with Nvidia, but this is "currently not possible anymore."

This is all to say that this AIB partner is unable to get the GPU and memory required to make the RTX 5090, and doesn't know when that supply issue will be fixed. Though this isn't the card being discontinued, for many partners, not getting the GPU and VRAM is as good as doing so.
Whether it's the GPU or the memory that's causing the biggest headache isn't specified, though in the current context, one can assume it's likely both to some degree.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dMHeoyF85ptrkZLthKfisE-1920-80.jpg

As of right now, companies are reliant on GPU and VRAM bundles from Nvidia before they can make their own cards. There have previously been r umours that Nvidia would stop bundling its GPUs and VRAM together , but even if it did that, this would only partly solve the issue of the memory crisis for Nvidia. Those who might have been able to buy just the GPU would still be subject to a price squeeze on the VRAM when trying to source it direct from one of the major memory manufacturers.

Der8auer also spoke to an RTX 5090 cooler manufacturer who said, "Two of our partners already reduced quite much the order forecast for RTX 5090 based heatsinks in Q1 2027, when compare[d] with Q3 2026."
"For Q2 2027, until now we still did not receive any order for RTX 5090 model heatsinks from our partners."

Nvidia still remains steadfast in saying the card has not been discontinued, though it acknowledges that limited supply chain capacity has led to a "somewhat constrained" output. Its German branch says, "Nvidia will continue to ship it, and this is very important."

The RTX 5090 (an already expensive card at its previous MSRP of $2,000) has been prohibitively expensive for months. It's so pricey, in fact, that we stopped tracking it in our graphics card price watch . It has been incredibly difficult to find any of the cards available from reputable sellers at even reasonable prices (with some listed for upwards of $8,000 right now ) and therefore we could never recommend actually picking one up. Though it may not be officially discontinued, it seems like the likelihood of picking one up soon at a decent price is getting slimmer and slimmer by the day.

items.summary: Playing music too loud on the subway? Believe it or not, straight to jail.

content.v: I've always thought that I'm a particularly good judge of character, so I was happy to put my theory to the test with Deadline: Afterlife Processing's new demo where you play as some corporate angel judging whether the souls of the recently deceased should go upstairs or downstairs (I think we all know what that means).

Deadline's demo starts like most stints in corporations do, with paperwork. I'm not entirely sure whether I signed my soul away, but I was sad to hear I won't be getting time off anytime soon. After I was done with all the bureaucracy it was time to get to work.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RAnQeqb4X8gp4JVfsUaGeE-1920-80.jpg

First thing's first, you need to clock in, every minute counts and you don't want to be late for work when your boss is either the creator of the universe or someone powerful enough to force the deceased into a suit and tie. The rest of my work day played out pretty normally: I'd grab a coffee, sift through some notes, and use this giant machine which can read the souls of humans and extrapolate key details of their life. This is what I used to decide if people had been naughty or nice.

Most of the souls that crossed my paths were pretty obvious. They'd either donated their lifesavings to charity or punched a random old lady in the street—figuring out who deserves to go to heaven or hell isn't exactly rocket science in these cases. There were, however, a couple of scenarios that had me stop and ponder the ethics of a given situation.

One soul that came to me on the second day of my job had killed a stranger on the subway. Now, this is obviously bad, you shouldn't kill people, but the stranger had been playing their music obnoxiously loud, no headphones or anything. That's not to say they had it coming, but I can't say that I don't at least understand where this person was coming from. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and sent them upstairs—hopefully the music isn't too loud up there.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ixjHmhLvR8uygWj47M7f9F-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QzZNrKoXKhay8PmzwQss3F-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/g5iBER9ZREqQg56JkEgw3F-1920-80.jpg

A second case that had me momentarily stumped involved a grumpy old man who never attended or donated money to the neighbourhood block parties. After thinking on it for all of one second I decided to send him upwards as well. You see, I also hate block parties, so not attending them is the right decision in my book.

I stand by my decisions, every single one of them. I think my nebulous boss liked them as well, because after a few days I was offered a fulltime position. This is when everything started getting weird.

I can't say what's wrong for sure as the demo ended not long after I was promoted but after finding a soul that could not be quantified I was sent down to storage to log it and store it for the foreseeable future. It was here that I encountered a soul orb that began glowing strangely and seemed as if it was trying to follow me out of the room. But managing the strange ethereal glow of abandoned souls isn't in my job description—I checked—so legally speaking that isn't my problem.

items.title: Xbox Workers Are Eligible For Buyouts As Part Of Huge Shakeup At Microsoft
items.summary: Microsoft has announced a new program called the Voluntary Exit Offer that it's extending to thousands of work

content.v: Microsoft has announced a new program called the Voluntary Exit Offer that it's extending to thousands of workers at the company, including people on the Xbox team.
Microsoft is doing this to shed employees, but the messaging is that a program like this could be appealing to someone who was already thinking about leaving and can now do so with a pay package.

Microsoft shared the high-level details of the Voluntary Exit Offer on its blog , and Bloomberg had more insight. The report said 60,000 workers are eligible for the Voluntary Exit Offer, and this works out to more than 25% of Microsoft's entire workforce.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Xbox-2.png?w=636

Bloomberg reported that Xbox is one of the divisions of Microsoft whose employees can leave the company via the Voluntary Exit Offer, along with Windows, Copilot, and finance teams. The report said people working on Microsoft's efforts in data centers, sales, marketing, cyber security, and quantum computing are not eligible.

Microsoft made this announcement just two days before it releases its next earnings report on October 28. The technology giant is spending hundreds of billions of dollars in its massive AI push, and many in the investment community have questioned if that level of capital expenditure makes sense.

In April this year, Microsoft offered a Voluntary Retirement Program, and it offered severance pay, ongoing stock vesting, and extended health benefits. About 33% of eligible workers took that deal. Mass layoffs came in July, affecting nearly 5,000 people, including major cuts at Xbox. Terms of the new Voluntary Exit Offer are not available, but a spokesperson told Bloomberg that those who take the offer will receive benefits similar to a severance package.

For Xbox specifically, it was reported that further layoffs could be announced in October , with another round set for November, and then another in January 2027. However, The Verge's Tom Warren said the October layoffs at Xbox are not happening this month, but will occur later. Xbox has been undergoing a "reset" under the leadership of CEO Asha Sharma, and this has included mass layoffs, studio closures, and game cancellations, among other dramatic moves.

These changes are happening at Microsoft amid huge surges in revenue and profitability for the company. For the latest period, Microsoft reported $90 billion in revenue (up 18%) and a profit of $35.8 billion (up 22%). As mentioned, the newest data will be revealed on October 28, so keep checking back for more.
CEO Satya Nadella addressed the seemingly discordant nature of cutting staff so massively at a time when the company is making so much money. In a memo , he said, "This is the enigma of success."

items.title: 日本人乐疯了！媒体玩《昭和米国物语》笑到肚子疼
items.summary: 近日，日本知名游戏媒体4Gamer试玩了由铃空游戏开发的新作《昭和米国物语》。

content.v: 近日，日本知名游戏媒体4Gamer试玩了由铃空游戏开发的新作《昭和米国物语》。
本次试玩版提供了“故事＆战斗”、“休息＆成长”等多个场景，这款自2022年公布起就因极其离谱的设定而备受瞩目的游戏，再次向玩家展示了其独一无二的“整活”实力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551291718.jpg
游戏的背景设定在虚构的昭和66年：日本凭借强大的经济实力买下了大半个美国，并在文化上全面主导，诞生了融合日美特征的“昭和美国”。
在这里，自由女神像穿上了和服，金门大桥挂上了巨大日式灯笼，好莱坞变成了“新横滨”。
然而，“大灾厄”突然降临，人类大多变成了僵尸。死而复生的女主角千草蝶子，为了寻找失踪的妹妹，踏上了横跨美国的公路之旅。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551367140.jpg
试玩的核心是战斗系统。玩家可以通过轻（□）重（△）攻击组合出丰富的连招，在按键顺序中衍生出高伤害或打断敌人动作的技能。玩家可以装备指虎、武士刀、美国国旗甚至电钻等多种近战武器，以及两种远程枪械。
战斗中最关键的是资源管理。攻击或受击会积攒“怒气槽（HG）”，转化为点数后可用于强化攻击、切换武器攻击或释放武器奥义。同时，“体力（ST）”不仅影响行动，还会直接影响防御力。体力越低，受到的伤害越高；停下行动或消耗怒气点数攻击可以恢复体力。这种机制鼓励玩家在攻防之间寻找平衡。当敌人被打破“Break”槽陷入僵直时，所受伤害将翻倍，并可以被主角华丽处决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551449044.jpg
让4Gamer编辑最为惊喜的是游戏无处不在的恶搞元素。在面对穿着昭和风体操服、涂着夸张涂料的敌对势力“勇士团”时，突然响起了极其熟悉的BGM——那竟然是《共和国战歌》（美国爱国歌曲，也是日本电器店友都八喜的经典店内BGM）。
这种强烈的反差和黑色幽默让编辑直呼“笑到肚子痛”，并将其比作“去掉了极道元素、塞满了搞笑桥段的《如龙》”。
在“休息＆成长”环节中，主角可以在专属列车“G-EX红莲特快”上休整。通过消耗探索获得的AP，玩家可以进行吃饭、锻炼、看漫画等活动，从而永久提升角色能力。
《昭和米国物语》预计将于2026年内发售，登陆PC、PS5及PS4平台。

content.v: 今日，苹果正式发布全新iMac，新机搭载M6芯片，起售价12499元，将于10月29日凌晨1点10分开启预购，11月6日正式发售。
全新iMac延续纤薄的一体式设计，提供蓝色、绿色、粉色、黄色、紫色、橙色和银色七款配色，兼顾桌面空间利用与个性化选择。
屏幕方面，新机配备24英寸4.5K视网膜显示屏，分辨率为4480x2520，亮度达到500尼特，支持P3广色域，可显示超过10亿种色彩。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261027_zy_red_164_17/1452.jpg
此外，新机还提供纳米纹理玻璃选项，能够减少反光和眩光，适合光线较强的使用环境。
全新iMac搭载苹果M6芯片，最高配备12核CPU和12核GPU，每个GPU核心均内置神经网络加速器，并搭载双16核神经网络引擎，内存带宽最高可达170GB/s。
苹果官方数据显示，与搭载M4芯片的上一代iMac相比，新机在生产力任务中的表现最高提升1.5倍，图形性能最高提升2倍，端侧AI性能最高提升5倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261027_zy_red_164_17/1908.jpg
AI体验也是此次升级的重要方向，全新iMac预装macOS 27，能够运行本地AI模型，并支持多种针对苹果芯片优化的AI应用。
苹果智能进一步融入系统和应用，可用于信息检索、写作辅助等任务。
不过，苹果智能在中国大陆的推出时间仍取决于监管审批。
新机配备1200万像素Center Stage摄像头，支持人物居中和桌上视角功能，方便用户进行视频会议或展示桌面内容。
音频系统采用六扬声器设计，支持空间音频和杜比全景声，同时配备录音棚级三麦克风阵列。
全新iMac支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6，可选配2.5Gb以太网接口，最多提供四个雷雳4端口，并支持外接两台6K显示器。
苹果还对存储性能进行了升级，官方称固态硬盘读写速度最高提升至上一代的2倍。

《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270947194543.png
IGN巴西的评测编辑表示，本作将《只狼》的弹反与破防、《忍者龙剑传》的连击以及《尼尔：机械纪元》的华丽视效完美融合。玩家需要高度专注，虽然不像魂系那么充满惩罚性，但极富挑战与爽快感。

Boss战是游戏最大的亮点，数量庞大、演出极其壮观。优秀的阶段保存机制（在二阶段死亡无需重打一阶段）极大地提升了体验。击败Boss还能直接获得并使用其特色武器。

items.title: NS2模拟器成功运行独占游戏！画面效果曝光 支持PC
items.summary: 今日，开发者avvsky（ovvvsky）于社交平台公布消息，由其主导开发的Compound，宣称是全球第一款能够正常运行的任天堂Switch2模拟器…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216003925.png
今日，开发者avvsky（ovvvsky）于社交平台公布消息，由其主导开发的Compound，宣称是全球第一款能够正常运行的任天堂Switch2模拟器，相关项目源码已经上传至GitHub。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216083305.png
根据项目介绍，Compound采用纯C语言开发，定位兼顾Switch1与Switch2两代主机的模拟方案，使用Ballistic ARM64重编译器实现高性能JIT，原生支持Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、ARM64等多平台，自带GUI调试界面、内存追踪与代码热重载等专业调试工具。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216188074.png
开发者在帖子附带截图展示成果：模拟器已经可以渲染出《马里奥网球 狂热》画面，角色模型、球场场景基本正常显示。不过作者着重强调，项目仍属于非常早期的实验版本，大量子系统还在开发中，包含不少临时的实验性补丁；但核心的指令执行、内存映射与图形渲染模块，已经实现基础可用。
本项目使用GPLv3开源协议，定位面向模拟器开发者、系统编程研究人员，用于硬件逆向与底层系统研究。需要注意，该模拟器属于非官方逆向工程产物，运行游戏需要游戏本体固件与ROM文件，存在版权风险，不建议普通玩家尝试。

在此，向所有支持AL的粉丝们郑重说一句：对不起。

items.title: 《生化危机》系列官宣或将迎结局！不靠一款游戏讲完
items.summary: 公司围绕《生化危机》制定的首个十年计划已经完成

content.v: 卡普空高级执行董事竹内润在系列周年采访中透露，公司围绕《生化危机》制定的首个十年计划已经完成，并暗示这个横跨多部作品的主线故事可能在未来十年内迎来结局。他表示，结局不会只靠一款游戏讲完，但具体会推出多少部作品，目前没有说明。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271716581143.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271717401863.png

竹内润回顾，这一长期规划最早在《生化危机2：重制版》开发时期成形。当时卡普空确立了十年的品牌概念，但故事本身并非从一开始就完整规划，而是随着每一部新作逐步调整，这也让不同作品之间的线索整合变得困难。他同时谈到系列此前的几次转折：《生化危机4》放弃洋馆、转向村庄和越肩视角时曾遭遇内部阻力；《生化危机6》则被他形容为旧点子堆砌、缺少新鲜身份。真正让系列找回方向的是《生化危机7》，他受卡普空会长委托接手这个陷入困境的项目，目标就是让恐惧重新成为核心，第一人称视角则让恐怖感更直接。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271717007837.png
2026年2月发售的《生化危机：安魂曲》被竹内润视为这一长期方向上的里程碑。游戏允许玩家在第一人称和第三人称之间切换，主角为新人格蕾丝与回归的里昂·肯尼迪。他还暗示《安魂曲》与《生化危机7》之间存在关联，并提到标题中的字母“q”代表数字9。按照他的说法，整个故事预计将在未来十年内走向收束。

items.title: NS2黑客重大突破！游戏文件能直接搬到PC了
items.summary: 该漏洞适用于Ver. 23.0.1固件，但未提供内核级权限。

content.v: 据Polygon报道，技术论坛GBAtemp上近期分享了一个针对Switch 2的新漏洞利用。它可以通过访问主机文件系统并操纵内存，把系统固件和游戏文件完整导出到PC。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105707.jpg
报道称，黑客此前已借助一款面向初学者的编程游戏《SmileBASIC4》来查看和修改Switch 2的文件系统，这次的新漏洞控制范围更大，文件系统里的内容都能被操作，导出游戏也在其中。该漏洞适用于Switch 2固件的Ver.23.0.1版本。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105708.jpg
对玩家来说，眼下还谈不上在PC上玩Switch 2游戏。报道明确指出，要等Switch 2模拟器开发出来，导出的游戏才可能运行；但文件能被导出，本身就让后续的改机和破解门槛降低了不少。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105709.jpg
报道同时给出了这次进展的边界：漏洞并未提供“内核级访问权限”，也就是还做不到对主机的完全控制。Polygon分析认为，这一发现将加速模拟器与逆向工程的尝试，也可能推动黑客继续往内核权限方向走。

items.title: 你就是赢不了——尽管《羊蹄之魂》销量数百万份，但据报道有 24 名员工被《Sucker Punch》解雇
items.summary: Are the "challenges in the market" in the room with us right now?

content.v: As we've noted before on this very site, there really is just no winning in the videogame industry , particularly under current conditions. Make an unsuccessful game? Make the kind of game you didn't want to make, but were pressured into? Layoffs. Make a successful game? Layoffs. Currently making a game? Believe it or not, layoffs.

As is the case with Ghost of Yōtei developer sucker punch, which has reportedly—per an internal email sent to Aftermath and confirmations from an ex-employee to the site—been hit with 24 layoffs, around a 10% reduction in staff.

This is despite the fact that Ghost of Yōtei, the studio's most recent game, was a commercial success: It sold 3.3 million copies in its opening month , making it the 11th-best selling game in the US in 2025. It continued to rake in the cash, hopping over 5 million copies in just a handful of months.

The email itself reads: "After carefully observing the challenges in the market and reviewing the team needs for our next project, we've decided to make some staffing reductions. Several positions across Sucker Punch will be eliminated as a result.

"We know this is a lot to take in, and we want to assure you that we did not make this decision lightly. We have given this a lot of attention and worked to support our affected colleagues during this transition as well as we can. … There's no getting around that this is a hard day. Next week we will go into more details about the future."

In—and I want to wrap this word up in air quotes here— fairness to Sony here, challenges in the market have been absolutely miserable. An AI bubble has sent everything tits-up for the foreseeable future, games are getting far more expensive to make , outpacing the prices at which they're sold, and Covid-19 overhiring didn't help .

And yet, part of me thinks you should be able to make a nearly top-10 selling videogame and probably be secure in your job for, like, a year at the very least. This doesn't smack as a sign of a healthy industry . Besides, it's not like you're seeing Sony's executive staff taking a pay cut.

items.title: 使用此技巧只需 85 美元即可在 PS5 上获取 GTA 6 终极版 - 仅限今天
items.summary: Today only, you can get a $100 PlayStation Store gift card for just $85 – and then use it to buy the Ultimate

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/untitled-design-5-1793107559234.png
Update Oct 27, 1pm ET: Unfortunately, this deal has sold out. I'll update this article if it comes back.

As a commerce editor at IGN, I’ve been on the lookout for the best possible deal on Grand Theft Auto 6 — almost certainly the biggest game of the year. Since no retailer is offering a direct discount on GTA 6, the best way I’ve found to save money on it is to buy a PlayStation or Xbox gift card when it’s discounted at Newegg.

Today only, Newegg has the best deal I’ve seen yet on a $100 PlayStation gift card . If you enter promo code GTWF2793 at checkout, you’ll save $15 — meaning you get $100 of PlayStation credit for $85 . That’s enough to buy you the Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6, the edition most people are preordering .
$100 PlayStation Store Digital Gift Card for $85

This is almost certainly the biggest discount we’ll see on gift cards ahead of GTA 6's November 19 launch, and thus the best deal available. In other words: if you want the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 and you want the best deal possible, now is the time to buy.

Once you buy the gift card (making double sure to use the promo code to get the deal), you should receive a code via email within an hour ( I just did it, and my code came six minutes after I placed the order ). You can redeem this code at the PlayStation Store for $100 in credit. To do so, just make sure you're signed in, and click your avatar in the upper right corner of the page. That will open a dropdown menu with the option "Redeem Code," where you can paste your code.
Now that you have your funds, head to the Grand Theft Auto 6 page (your choice of standard edition or ultimate edition ) and preorder the game. Then you’re all set.
Preorder Grand Theft Auto 6 - Ultimate Edition

What do you get with the ultimate edition? To quote Rockstar, it includes “an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story.” Here's a full rundown.
GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Includes:
Exclusive Vehicles & Storage
Extra Vehicle Content
Exclusive Weapons
Additional Missions & Activities
Cosmetics & Character Customization
You can find more info in our GTA 6 preorder guide .

While you can’t play the game until it comes out on November 19, you’ll be able to pre-load it onto your PS5 starting on November 12. That gives you a week to download it ahead of launch, so you don’t have to worry about slow network speeds once the game is available. Then, once November 19 rolls around, the game will unlock and you’ll be able to play the biggest game of the year.

If you'd rather have a physical copy, that's cool – but I don't expect any deals or discounts to be available anywhere on physical copies. It's also worth noting that Grand Theft Auto 6 is only available in digital form. While Rockstar will sell you a “physical copy” ( see it at Amazon ), all you actually get is a game box with a download code in it. No discs for the game are being printed. So if you do want to save $15, this deal on PlayStation Store credit is the one to buy.

content.v: It's been 22 years, 11 months, 28 days and counting since we were first graced with Call of Duty . Over those two decades the franchise has emerged as one of the most lucrative in videogame history, with Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announcing that it's passed the $40billion revenue mark.

Speaking of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's success, Sharma reflects : "One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40 billion in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us."

One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us. https://t.co/AlpXydEQIQ October 26, 2026

$40 billion in lifetime revenue places Call of Duty behind goliaths like Mario and Pokémon. It also means that Call of Duty, on average, has earned $4,762,472 a day, which is particularly terrifying if you ask me.

But how it got there is an entirely different question—one that can be answered by the ravenous appetite of consumers in the free market. Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 still sits at the top spot with over 43 million copies sold, with Modern Warfare (2019) comes in a close second with over 41 million copies sold. But by and large, the popularity of Call of Duty is driven by Black Ops, namely its older titles.

The prize for most successful launch, however, has to go to Modern Warfare 2 (2022) which earned $1 billion in just 10 days alongside 200 million hours played. This followed Activision Blizzard's sale to Microsoft, which also meant that Modern Warfare 2 was the first time a Call of Duty game had been on Steam since 2017 with Call of Duty: WW2 —it even made it into Steam's top 10 games by concurrent players.

The ridiculous release schedule of one Call of Duty game a year certainly seems to be working for Activision. I doubt it would've been able to pass this landmark without the tireless work of Infinity Ward, Treyarch, Sledgehammer Games, and Raven Software pumping out something new year after year. At this rate I'm pretty sure the Call of Duty franchise will outlive us all. Picture this: the dry arid landscape of an Earth pillaged and then left void of humanity, with the sole proof of our existence being the 15th Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 remaster (2193)—I hope it's good.

content.v: 黑暗日式恐怖角色扮演游戏《电电：东京恐怖》现已登陆Steam，国区首发特惠7.7折，原价76.5元，当前售价58.95元。游戏获得玩家“多半好评”评价。故事发生在东京的一夜之间，玩家将扮演照顾被遗弃老人的照护者，在资源无法帮助所有人的情况下，必须赶在黎明前决定优先拯救谁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793108676_983815_jpg_r.jpg
游戏进程实时推进，留给玩家权衡选择的时间有限。玩家需要探索废弃公寓和昏暗街巷，寻找补给、回收途中发现的垃圾、照料老人，并收集具有不同超自然效果的护符。
探索期间，玩家还会遇到城市中的其他居民。除了使用刀具、电击器、手枪等拾取到的武器自卫，玩家也能通过交谈、撒谎、威胁或安抚处理冲突。不同决定将改变人物关系，并影响周围角色的命运。
随着黎明临近，一种与忽视、悔恨及主角过往错误有关的邪恶存在也会在城中苏醒。任何角色都有可能死亡，部分选择造成的后果无法挽回。游戏将资源管理、限时决策、探索与多路径交涉结合，玩家需要在持续增加的压力下承担每次取舍带来的结果。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793108996_483727_jpg_r.jpg
关于此游戏
Den-Den: Tokyo Horror 是一款日式恐怖RPG，每一个选择都承载着人命的重量。
日本出生率早已崩溃。老龄人口是年轻人的三倍以上，东京正在缓缓死去。 残酷的地缘政治封锁切断了食物、药品和电力供给，社会正在分崩离析，暴力犯罪激增。
你扮演一名看护者，任务是在一整夜里让被忽视的老人活下去。唯一的问题是：物资不足以供应所有人。
太阳升起时，他们之中还有多少人能活着?
欢迎来到 Den-Den: Tokyo Horror。 这个故事没有圆满结局。
主要特色
事件以实时方式展开，游戏发生在单一的一夜之中。
每过一小时，城市就会陷入更深的混乱。时间始终向前推进，你的每一个选择都会产生后果。
管理有限的物资，同时在城市中搜刮任何能找到的东西，以再多存活一小时。
利用散布在城市各处的回收机器，将垃圾变成宝物。
进入城市中分布的噩梦般的老年居住设施，照顾你所负责的被忽视的老人。
收集并装备强大的护符，获得超自然祝福。
使用厨房刀、泰瑟枪、黑市手枪等临时武器战斗或逃跑。
你的行为会带来永久后果。游戏中的每一个角色都可能因你而死。
拾荒
翻遍废弃公寓、溢出的垃圾箱、黑暗小巷，只为找到能多活一晚的东西——食物、止痛药、电池、子弹……或者一无所获。
发现
对话、倾听、撒谎、威胁或安慰。每段对话都会分支，每段关系都可能救你或毁掉你想保护的人。
战斗或逃离
绝望的市民、暴力罪犯以及更可怕的东西在街头游荡。挥舞生锈的菜刀、颤抖着开枪、用电击枪麻痹敌人，或者只是逃跑——不惜一切活到天亮。
恐惧
城市最黑暗的角落里，某种邪恶之物已经苏醒。 它以疏忽、後悔和错误决定为食。 如果你犯下太多错误……它会找上你，以及你没能守护的所有人。

items.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered Doesn’t Change Much, And That’s A Good Thing
items.summary: The Wolf Among Us 2 is finally landing in 2027, and if you want to catch up on what many consider one of Tellt

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/thewolfamongus-remastered-blogroll-01-1793073503798.jpg

With intense performances, a heady atmosphere, and sharp writing, The Wolf Among Us’ gripping neo-noir saga rivalled the prestige TV dramas of the time when it first came out in 2013, earning acclaim as one of Telltale’s greatest yet. Now, with a long-awaited sequel in the works, it’s been given a fresh coat of paint that’s gussied up locations and added a slew of behind-the-scenes content to sweeten the pot. Some holdover annoyances haven’t been addressed, like the original’s stiff and occasionally uncanny animations, which get in the way of The Wolf Among Us Remastered feeling truly definitive. Still, this story remains a fantastic one, and the enhanced set dressing even manages to deepen its sinister mood.

For those who didn’t play the original, The Wolf Among Us thoughtfully adapts Bill Willingham’s beloved graphic novel series Fables, in which folklore characters covertly coexist with humans in a New York suburb aptly called Fabletown. Set roughly 20 years earlier as a non-canon prequel, Telltale’s adaptation artfully draws on classic noir storytelling, dropping you into the shoes of Sheriff Bigby (aka the Big Bad Wolf) to solve a bizarre but gripping murder. With a decapitated head on his stoop and little more to go on than a ribbon and an etched ring, the marshal must use his keen nose and perception to find the culprit… and he has to do it fast. With humans investigating the case and the social fabric of the mythical community at stake, failure could cause their secret society to collapse entirely.

On top of that already immense pressure, there’s one more important piece of subtext to consider: after centuries of violence as a storybook baddie, Bigby’s constituents don’t necessarily trust him to get the job done and, naturally, watch his every move. As such, he’s forced to lean on familiar faces like Snow White, The Little Mermaid, and Bufkin from The Wizard of Oz to chase leads as he unravels a web of complex issues spanning class consciousness, poverty, and abuses of power. It’s a journey that proves to be thoroughly engrossing.

To peel back the seedy underbelly of Fabletown, your time as Bigby is loosely split into segments. For the most part, you’ll have intriguing conversations from a third-person perspective, choosing from a handful of responses as a clock quickly ticks down. Through this system, you can lean on witnesses who seem to be hiding something, threatening them if they continue to hold back. Or, if all else fails, you can resort to physical violence (assuming that aligns with your own moral compass). Cleverly, the language used in these interactions draws on its fairy tale source material without ever feeling corny. So, despite including terms like Witching Well and Magic Mirror, the conversations remain emotionally charged – a tribute to the writing underneath and the resonant, enduring performances of its cast.

What’s most important is that your reactions here are not one-sided. As you make certain decisions, a threatening notification pops up stating that the character you’re interacting with will remember what you did (a staple of the genre). For example, say you make a promise to deliver something and don’t come through – well, they might have a few choice words for you the next time you meet. In this way, The Wolf Among Us is not just about solving the whodunit; it is also about choosing whether Bigby will shake off his villainous origins and prove his status as Sheriff and protector.

What’s neat is that the choice is mostly up to you. If you want to, you can cruelly push the citizens to get your answers, or try as often as you might to take their side, even if that means going against the legal institution to which you are professionally bound. By exploring this curious grey area, I began to understand why the residents of Fabletown act as they do, eventually allowing me to empathise with their actions, no matter how desperate or depraved they may be.

Amidst these social calls, you’ll occasionally control Bigby directly as he picks through dingy locations – such as dive bars and ornate offices – interacting with clues to advance the investigation. Just like in conversations, there are even more ethical quandaries to consider, like whether you should interrupt a wake like an unemotional jerk or kick in a door instead of knocking like a gentleman. As the confusing haze of right and wrong settled in, I frequently struggled to maintain my good-guy persona, especially when provoked. It would be so easy to smack an obvious bad guy in the head to get the answers I needed more quickly, but then wouldn’t I be just as bad as him?

Last but not least are the interactive sequences, which require you to complete a series of quick time events to survive some of the higher octane moments throughout the tale. You’ll rip out throats, jump across city blocks, and even set broken bones, with failure occasionally leading to a game over. Thankfully, frequent checkpoints drop you right back into the action if you miss a beat. The variety and frequency of these moments do well to keep you busy as you piece together the killer's identity, particularly as many of them arrive with mesmerising (and sometimes gruesome) animations.

Mirroring the flow of the original, The Wolf Among Us Remastered takes place over five episodes that are about two hours long (all included in this single package instead of being sold individually). For the most part, the choices you make feel impactful, which keeps the momentum chugging along nicely. That is, until the penultimate episode, when the pace suddenly dips and characters start needlessly reiterating their points of view. In earlier episodes, I’d look under every stone to figure out who the villain was, and I was fairly confident I understood what was going on by episode four, so everything slowing down right when I was ready for the payoff felt slightly disjointed.

I do get why they didn’t alter this chapter more substantially; this is a remaster, not a remake, and major story alterations could ultimately do more harm than good if handled poorly. Besides, there are still enjoyable chats throughout the episode, so the dragging is only a minor blip in an otherwise brilliant story, with a finale that certainly clawed me back. But when the rest of the tale is so tight and considered, it’s still a bit annoying to spend a couple of hours rehashing information you’ve already worked hard to uncover.

That dissatisfaction is also softened by the fact that the locations you visit are so intentionally designed and brilliantly reflect the personalities of their inhabitants. While Bigby's tiny, sparsely furnished flat fits with his lone wolf status, the local watering hole’s scrappy yet warm atmosphere matches its down-on-their-luck clientele. The remaster's design glow-up further bolsters that environmental storytelling, as everything from couch upholstery to pawn shop artefacts has been redesigned with far more detail. For instance, those familiar with Aunt Greenleaf's apartment will see that it’s now even witchier than before, with hanging tassels and strewn curios. Elsewhere, the infamous Puddin ‘n’ Pie remains seedy but stylish, featuring Art Nouveau-esque pendant lights and extravagant neon piping.

items.title: BioShock Movie Is Still Happening, But Director Says It’s A “Tough Nut To Crack”
items.summary: A BioShock movie at Netflix remains in development, its director has confirmed, but that doesn't necessarily m

content.v: A BioShock movie at Netflix remains in development, its director has confirmed, but that doesn't necessarily mean it'll ever be made. Francis Lawrence confirmed to The Direct that he hopes to make the BioShock movie, but "it's tricky on a couple fronts."
Lawrence said he is "definitely active" in working on the BioShock movie, but "it is a tough nut to crack that world and that story."

"You are the character when you play the game, and so creating that character from scratch into that world that, you know, quite honestly, is pretty batsh** in a most amazing way," he said. "It's tricky. So we're getting there, and we're getting close, which is great."

The BioShock movie was originally set to be a large-scale production, but when Netflix film chief Dan Lin came in, the project was scaled back . Lin recently left Netflix amid a major shakeup at the streaming giant, as did longtime chief content officer Bela Bajaria. Former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice is now the new chief content officer, and Lawrence hopes the management shakeups do not affect the BioShock movie in a big way, but nothing is ever certain in Hollywood.

"I would love nothing more than to be able to make that movie," Lawrence said of BioShock. "So still working on it. And then, you have also just the Netflix of it all because Netflix right now has had regime changes and just all of that kind of nonsense that I don't like to have to deal with or have to. So we'll see. Hopefully we'll figure it out."

Lawrence's latest project is the Hunger Games movie Sunrise on the Reaping, which releases in November. Asked if BioShock would be his next project, Lawrence said, "You never know." He said working on multiple films simultaneously creates a "horse race" kind of scenario where factors like the script, talent availability, and production realities need to align for projects to go ahead.

Curiously, BioShock producer Roy Lee said the BioShock movie is planned to coincide with the release of a new BioShock game . Lee did not name any specific games outright, but Take-Two recently reiterated that the long-in-development BioShock 4 will see the light of day … some day.

content.v: 10月27日晚，中国足协通过官方微博就姆巴佩涉华不当言论作出回应。中国足协表示，效力于西班牙皇家马德里俱乐部的运动员姆巴佩在接受海外媒体采访时公开发表涉华错误言论，中国足协高度重视，已第一时间与皇家马德里俱乐部进行严正交涉，要求涉事球员和皇家马德里俱乐部作出公开正式道歉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272134133808.png
中国足协在声明中强调，坚决反对任何伤害中国人民感情的言论，并指出国际知名运动员尤其应当严守底线、理性发声，珍惜自身公众影响力。中国足协同时表示，将充分利用国际多边交流平台，倡导相互尊重的国际足球交流交往准则，共同促进足球运动的健康发展与文明互鉴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272136195268.png

照片显示，谢浩飞的五官与父亲颇为相似。8岁的女儿Mia也在旅途中现身，她在喂兔子时面对镜头摆出姿势。目前，谢天华本人尚未对这些照片及子女近况作出新回应。
谢天华曾在《学警狙击》中饰演梁笑棠，近年还参与《大湾仔的夜》等综艺节目。此次引起关注的并非其新影视项目或公开演艺活动，而是一家人在成都旅行期间流出的生活画面。
谢天华与交往12年的李天恩于2005年结婚。两人婚后一度未能生育，据称曾花费60万港元并接受四次人工受孕疗程，2015年迎来儿子谢浩飞；2018年，时年45岁的李天恩生下女儿Mia。

items.title: Peter Molyneux speaks candidly about AI: 'We, as the industry, are pretending we're not using AI, but the reality is, it's almost impossible to code now without using AI'
items.summary: The father of the god game weighs in on AI use in the gaming industry

content.v: Recently, I travelled to Guildford, England, to interview developer Peter Molyneux, the legendary game developer behind Populous, Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Black & White and Fable, among others.

And, as part of that interview, which covered everything from Molyneux's brand-new god game, Masters of Albion , which has just got a huge game-changing update , through the moment he conceptualized Black & White's famous titan creatures , and onto the bombshell news that a Black & White remaster could be incoming , I also asked the father of the god game genre about AI use in the video game industry.

Molyneux is a gaming industry veteran, having been active in the gaming industry for over 40 years, so naturally his take on the rise of AI in game development was of interest. This is what he said when I asked if the gaming industry should embrace AI.
Then naturally, I asked, how so?

At this point, I asked Molyneux how AI was such a big step forward for studios, as, at least from my point of view, that has often been something not clarified well over the past few years of AI discourse. What are the everyday game development examples of how AI is being such a transformative tool for game studios of all sizes? This is what Molyneux said.
It feels inevitable, for better and worse

What struck a chord with me during this interview was Molyneux's belief that, within a year, AI will be so fundamentally built into key game development middleware like Unreal Engine and Unity that it will be almost impossible to not use AI in the creation of a new game. That just rang so true to me as soon as he had said it. It felt inevitable. Very few studios have their own proprietary tools/engines, and even if they did, if AI can indeed make game development easier, why wouldn't they adopt it into their own tech? I'm neither massively pro AI nor anti-AI in game development; it's clearly how the tech is used, and to what extent, that is key, but I'm not sure ignoring it entirely solves anything.

However, I think there is a clear difference between using AI-powered development tools and middleware to help create quality games powered by real human passion and performance, and churning out a non-stop slurry of AI slop loaded with AI assets and poorly implemented AI-coded systems in order to make a quick buck. We're clearly living through very turbulent times in the gaming industry right now, and the rise of AI in game development is just one facet of that, but it feels like there's plenty of change yet to come, and that will likely be both for the better and worse.

content.v: 据央视新闻报道，最近，演员吴越在社交媒体发声，怒斥一个账号用AI克隆她的脸和声音卖货。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261027_zy_red_164_16/144.jpg
发现侵权视频后，她曾尝试投诉，但效率太低，“你说是假的，但要把这个事情告诉大家，有很多步骤，有些时候还完不成，就投诉失败，很无奈。”最终，她选择在社交媒体发声，发文后不久，侵权视频已被下架。有类似遭遇的还有奥运冠军全红婵、演员王劲松、演员温峥嵘等。演员温峥嵘也反映，自己冲进假冒直播间质问时被直接拉黑，"现在很难证明我是我。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261027_zy_red_164_16/1210.jpg
AI合成账号常只直播十几二十分钟就结束，截图留证时直播已终止；部分侵权主体信息不透明，实际控制者可能在境外，追责困难。近八成涉诉AI侵权案件为肖像权纠纷，但维权成功并拿到赔偿的案例并不多。
北京海淀区人民法院的法官对相关案件梳理发现，目前利用生成式人工智能侵害肖像权，已日益呈现由民事侵权向刑事犯罪演变的态势。

items.title: 西甲官方就姆巴佩言论道歉！言论仅代表球员个人
items.summary: 西甲联盟通过官方微博发布声明

content.v: 10月27日，西甲联盟通过官方微博发布声明，就基利安·姆巴佩近期涉华不当言论向中国球迷致歉。声明表示，对于姆巴佩言论给中国球迷带来的冒犯与伤害，西甲联盟“深感遗憾”，并强调“相关言论属于球员个人表达，绝不代表西甲联盟的立场”。作为联赛管理机构，西甲联盟代表联盟及旗下所有俱乐部，向中国球迷致以“诚挚的歉意”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272108371740.png
西甲联盟在声明中重申了对中国市场的重视：“我们始终对中国、各相关机构及中国人民怀有深切的敬意，也无比珍视数百万中国球迷每周给予我们的关注与支持。”声明同时透露，联盟正与中国的合作伙伴及相关机构共同努力妥善处理此次事件，并将携手各俱乐部及球员“建立并推行文化认知与沟通规范”，以避免类似情况再次发生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272109136808.png
同日，姆巴佩本人通过个人社交媒体发布了法语、中文和英语三语致歉声明。他在声明中表示：“在近期的一次采访中，我对一张以我为主角的图片作出了回应。我的言论欠妥，如今我明白，这些话伤害了中国以及世界各地华人社区的许多人。我向所有被我的言论所伤害的人道歉。这绝非我的本意。我对中国人民及其历史怀有深深的敬意，我真心感到抱歉。”

items.title: iPhone Duo被曝为赶产能放宽质检！苹果官方回应
items.summary: 快科技10月27日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo自上周开售以来，陆续出现屏幕故障投诉。

content.v: 快科技10月27日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo自上周开售以来，陆续出现屏幕故障投诉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272106084091.png
部分用户反映，新机使用时间仅数小时，内屏便出现开裂。
据媒体报道，有富士康员工透露，iPhone Duo上市初期产能较为紧张，苹果此前曾下调部分质检标准以保障产品供应，这可能增加存在潜在缺陷的设备流入市场的风险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272105555600.png
针对相关传闻，苹果官方客服予以否认，并表示：“我们苹果是一家非常注重产品工艺和用户体验的公司，每一台出厂的产品在交付到用户之前，都会有严格的质检，并不会说因为产能的原因就会缺少某些工序，这个是不会的。”
对于近期出现的屏幕故障，苹果公司此前发表声明，承认少量iPhone Duo的内屏确实存在问题，但强调绝大多数设备不受影响。
相关故障通常会在设备使用初期显现，遇到问题的用户可以联系AppleCare申请换机。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272106017687.png
不过，即使确认设备存在故障，部分用户的换机流程也并不顺利。
据报道，美国弗吉尼亚州一名用户表示，当地苹果门店确认其设备存在产品缺陷，但由于售后服务预约已满，无法及时处理。
随后，该用户转至另一家门店完成检测，却又因设备缺货而继续等待换机。

items.title: 《昭和米国物语》日本人玩爽了！笑点不断 无厘头恶搞
items.summary: 近日，日本游戏媒体4Gamer发布了《昭和米国物语》的现场试玩评测。在10月24日至25日举办的G-Fusion Game Fest 2026展会上，铃空游戏…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272047181131.jpg
近日，日本游戏媒体4Gamer发布了《昭和米国物语》的现场试玩评测。在10月24日至25日举办的G-Fusion Game Fest 2026展会上，铃空游戏展出了这款仍在开发中的动作RPG，本次提供的试玩内容和科隆游戏展版本保持一致。
试玩版分为剧情战斗、休息成长、关卡探索、BOSS战四段独立切片，媒体在有限时间内体验了剧情战斗与休息成长两大模块。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272047233304.jpg
据4Gamer的试玩报道，本作的战斗系统设计有完整深度，玩家可以组合轻重攻击打出连招，可切换拳套、武士刀、星条旗、钻头等多种近战武器，同时携带两把远程武器。
战斗核心为怒气槽机制，攻击或受伤积攒怒气点数，可用来释放强化攻击、武器切换必杀与奥义。游戏还有体力值系统，体力越低受到伤害越高，使用怒气强化招式能够直接回满体力；敌人存在破防条，击破后进入易伤状态，玩家可触发处决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272047321011.png
除扎实的动作框架外，4Gamer重点夸赞本作的恶搞桥段。末世背景之下没有沉重压抑的氛围，荒诞角色与玩梗BGM接连登场，例如自称丧尸人权活动家的奇特NPC，以及身着昭和体操服、涂装夸张的敌对势力“勇士团”。
评测编辑表示，本作早已超出普通恶搞游戏的水平，短短试玩过程中笑点接连不断，仿佛剥离了极道元素、塞满喜剧桥段的《如龙》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272047409911.jpeg
营地休息模块同样可供体验，主角可在红莲特快房车中休息，消耗AP值进行吃饭、锻炼、阅读漫画等活动，以此提升自身属性。

items.title: 《EA SPORTS FC 27》1.1.0版更新修复生涯模式、终极球队等大量问题
items.summary: Electronic Arts于10月27日为《EA SPORTS FC 27》推出1.1.0版大型更新，集中修复生涯模式、终极球队、俱乐部、The Grounds及界面操作中的大量故障。本次更新没有调整比赛平衡或数值。

content.v: Electronic Arts于10月27日为《EA SPORTS FC 27》推出1.1.0版大型更新，集中修复生涯模式、终极球队、俱乐部、The Grounds及界面操作中的大量故障。本次更新没有调整比赛平衡或数值。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793101067_419949_jpg_r.jpg
主机端显示的补丁编号为1.000.008，另有同源信息将其称为1.07，新旧世代平台采用相同的补丁说明。修复内容包括开场教程可能卡住、PC端用键鼠控制门将时鼠标失灵、部分转会市场搜索按钮无法使用，以及保存新战术后球员位置错误等问题。部分菜单无法返回或必须重启游戏的异常也得到处理。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793101072_179843_jpg_r.jpg
终极球队模式缩短了开包动画，玩家连续完成简化SBC时也可保留筛选条件。此次更新还修正了球员物品、目标计数、奖励提示、球网颜色、比赛叠加界面及Gallery导航等显示或操作异常。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793101081_505280_jpg_r.jpg
俱乐部与The Grounds方面，匹配队列卡死、跨平台提示后无限加载、11对11比赛出现两名门将，以及街头 足球 和小游戏判定异常等情况均列入修复范围。
更新还为球员生涯的竞争关系加入“一致性竞争”和“限时竞争”两类目标，并调整球队管理界面。经理生涯玩家现在可以在存档过程中修改发布会、互动频率和意外事件相关设置。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: DeepSeek梁文锋被曝长期租房！千亿身价 低调务实
items.summary: 快科技10月27日消息，据媒体援引知情人士消息，DeepSeek办公地主要在北京和杭州。创始人梁文锋长期在北京租房居住，房间布置一直比…

content.v: 快科技10月27日消息，据媒体援引知情人士消息，DeepSeek办公地主要在北京和杭州。创始人梁文锋长期在北京租房居住，房间布置一直比较简单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272034113690.jpg
值得一提的是，就在今日（10月27日），胡润研究院发布《2026胡润百富榜》。41岁的DeepSeek创始人梁文锋首次上榜，便以2800亿元财富位列榜单第七，跻身前十席位胡润百富。
坐拥千亿身家，依旧选择租房生活，也和他一贯低调务实的风格相印证。在行业热度高涨、资本争相入局的背景下，梁文锋没追逐浮华，极少对外曝光，在喧嚣的AI赛道里格外低调。
伴随公司快速成长，DeepSeek的融资动作也备受关注。近期，多家媒体报道称，DeepSeek即将完成新一轮融资，规模约为1000亿元人民币。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272034181241.png
据相关报道，这轮融资的计划规模从最初的500亿元上调至800亿元，随后进一步增至约1000亿元。
加上今年6月首轮约510亿元融资，DeepSeek半年内的累计融资规模或达到约1500亿元人民币。具体融资金额和投资方名单仍有待公司进一步披露。
此外，本月还有消息显示，梁文锋近期密集关注具身智能领域，并与多位该领域创业者交流，探讨机器人、大模型与现实世界交互等方向。
与此同时，DeepSeek也敲定了重要算力落地计划，把目光投向内蒙古乌兰察布。
知情人士称，这家AI独角兽计划在当地建设一座GW级数据中心，部署至少16万颗华为昇腾950DT芯片。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272034269700.png
按照媒体披露的最新报价测算，仅这批芯片的名义采购金额就超过400亿元，尚未计入机房和电力等配套设施。

items.summary: "双点酒店"，Steam模拟经营神作《酒店建筑师》首个"海岛"DLC即将上线

content.v: 在《酒店建筑师》中，创意与混乱碰撞交织！这是一款可无限重玩的酒店建造与经营管理游戏。你将亲手设计并建造遍布全球的豪华酒店，应对性格各异、要求繁杂的客人，合理调配多种类型的员工，赢得评论家的认可，斩获梦寐以求的五星评级！
本次更新加入了新物品和电视频道，带来多项体验优化与Bug修复！新增电视频道玩法、新增灌木、树木，以及可显示酒店当前星级的多款酒店招牌，以及更多菜单栏位……还有更多体验优化内容等待探索！
感兴趣的玩家，可以复制下方链接跳转商店页，将游戏加入购物车！
APP用户【一键加入愿望单】
《 酒店建筑师 》宣传片：
在《酒店建筑师》里，你将亲自主导酒店从无到有的全过程，走遍世界打造地标级豪华酒店。从空间规划、装修搭配到服务运营，每一处细节都由你亲手掌控。游戏提供海量装饰、家具、壁纸与地板自由搭配，桑拿区、酒吧、休闲区随心布局，让你的酒店拥有独一无二的风格气质。
经营并非一帆风顺，你需要应对挑剔客人、突发状况、客流波动，招待专业酒店评论家，平衡收支与团队配置，用策略与审美冲击最高五星评级。准备好开启您的《酒店建筑师》之旅! 一同期待您的宾客们入住吧！
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/03/13/origin_202603132046546869.gif
游戏带来两种核心体验，满足不同玩家的建造与经营需求：
生涯模式，一步步完成经营目标，把破旧地块改造成繁华商圈，或将空地建成摩天酒店，体验从 0 到 1 的创业成长。
沙盒模式，摆脱资源限制，自由规划楼层、功能区与装修风格，尽情释放设计灵感，打造心中的完美酒店。
记住一切都是实时进行的，所以建造需要精心规划：当心不要打扰或移除客人正在使用的物品——否则他们可能会留下差评的！
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/03/13/origin_202603132047179021.gif

items.title: Rockstar确认《GTA6》部分剧情任务可选择多条路线
items.summary: 围绕《GTA6》的最大疑问之一，是R星会在剧情任务中给予玩家多大的自由，尤其是开发商承诺，本作将拥有其迄今为止规模最大、细节最丰富的开放世界。《GTA》系列一向允许玩家在主线任务之外自由行动，但在推进剧情时却未必如此。R

content.v: 围绕《GTA6》的最大疑问之一，是R星会在剧情任务中给予玩家多大的自由，尤其是开发商承诺，本作将拥有其迄今为止规模最大、细节最丰富的 开放世界 。《GTA》系列一向允许玩家在主线任务之外自由行动，但在推进剧情时却未必如此。R星的任务通常具有浓厚的电影化风格，并会设置玩家必须遵循的特定目标和流程，即便开放世界看起来提供了无穷无尽的可能性。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793100389_299938_jpg_r.jpg

在《GTA6》中，R星似乎正在有意识地调整这种平衡，同时又不牺牲已经成为该系列重要组成部分的叙事。今年8月，Netflix的《GTA6》加长展示公开了杰森和露西亚的实机画面，其中包括两人从一栋公寓楼中仓皇逃脱，以及一场牵涉劳尔的警方追逐。乍看之下，这两个片段似乎都经过了高度脚本化处理，但其背后的实际机制显然比画面呈现出来的更加复杂。事实上，R星目前已经对这些任务的实际运作方式作出了一些颇为有趣的说明。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793100399_378510_jpg_r.jpg
R星Games就《GTA6》加长展示中的玩法内容发布了一份新的官方声明，确认部分剧情任务提供了多种完成目标的方式。R星罗布·纳尔逊在接受IGN采访时解释说，开发商正努力赋予玩家更多任务内的自由，同时不影响任务的电影化效果。纳尔逊特别提到了Netflix加长展示中的两个片段，并表示玩家不一定只能沿着画面所展示的路线行动：

“你们在[Netflix加长展示]中看到的第一个任务里，他们身处一栋高层住宅楼，并试图逃出去。离开那栋楼有多条路线。还有一个任务是他们与劳尔会面，劳尔坐进汽车后座。任务开始时的流程是固定的，因为玩家控制杰森负责射击，露西亚则负责开车，但之后控制权会切换，由你来驾驶。游戏会提示一条最佳逃脱路线，但即使你不按这条路线走，也仍然可以成功脱身——这个任务本质上就是一场警方追逐。只要某个任务能够转入由系统驱动的状态，比如进入通缉等级系统或抢劫系统，我们就会努力避免让它给人一种与开放世界运行方式脱节的感觉。”
纳尔逊的说法表明，在某些情况下，《GTA6》的开放世界将比《给他爱5》更加灵活，允许玩家以不同方式完成目标，同时又不会导致任务中断。从公寓楼中逃脱就是一个很好的例子，因为玩家显然不会每次都被迫从完全相同的出口离开。牵涉劳尔的片段或许更加有趣，因为它展现了《GTA6》将如何在脚本化玩法与开放世界系统之间完成过渡。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793100402_574997_jpg_r.jpg
任务开始时，杰森负责射击，露西亚负责驾驶;但当玩家接管车辆后，便可以自行选择路线甩掉警察。R星仍会提供一条最佳路线，但玩家并非必须沿着这条路线行驶，这或许会让重复游玩变得更有趣。开发团队的目标似乎是让这些过渡显得更加自然，而不是把《GTA6》的剧情任务和自由探索当成两种完全割裂的体验。
当然，这并不意味着《GTA6》的每个任务都会允许玩家随心所欲。纳尔逊承认，某些叙事环节仍然需要更明确的引导，尤其是在R星必须确保特定事件发生、以维持剧情合理性的时候。不过，开发商显然正在寻找合适的机会，尽可能给予玩家更多控制权。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《轮回之兽》最终更新上线！61元实体盘 真跳楼价
items.summary: 《轮回之兽》是一款由《宝可梦》系列开发商Game Freak出品的一款动作游戏，已于8月4日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5/Xbox平台。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272019099644.png
《轮回之兽》是一款由《宝可梦》系列开发商Game Freak出品的一款动作游戏，已于8月4日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5/Xbox平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272019223085.png
近日，《轮回之兽》开发团队发布第九次更新公告，这也是游戏自发售以来定期发布上线后更新的最后一次。官方在公告中明确表示，本次更新标志着“游戏定期发布上线后更新的阶段正式结束”。
以下为本次更新公告全文：
各位玩家好！感谢大家游玩并支持《轮回之兽》。这是游戏自发售以来的第九次更新，主要包含以下内容：
新功能与玩法调整
现在玩家可以在营地以及净化船内部的床铺菜单中更换艾玛的服装
各个区域中新增了不同的服装款式。探索过程中获得新的服装款式后，即可切换穿着
新增继承功能：开始新游戏+时，可以继承装备、服装及外观皮肤
在培育室中新增了“生长加速”功能。击败敌人即可获得加速次数，用于缩短作物的生长时间
优化了培育室的运行逻辑。启用“自动”设置后，只要玩家持有作物种子，系统就会确保至少种植一颗种子
为Boss新增了攻击招式，并调整了其行为逻辑与攻击模式
重新调整了普通敌人与霸主的整体数值及属性平衡
调整了部分绽放技与剑技的技能强度
优化了武器切换机制。现在，玩家可以在普通攻击过程中以及居合架势下切换远程武器
调整了防御操作方式：现在需要按住防御键才能持续进行防御
优化了斩击的目标判定，使攻击在垂直方向能够更好地对准目标敌人
在按键设置中新增了“共鸣超载”选项，支持自定义按键绑定及保存设置
优化了按键设置中的冲突提示。当玩家将同一按键分配给无法共存的操作时，系统会发出警告（例如在切换弹药栏时同时设置锁定目标操作）
新增对PS5DualSense手柄触摸板操作的支持，并优化了对应的按键图标显示
过场动画与剧情事件持续优化
调整了多个事件场景中的对话节奏与场景播放时序
修复了跳过部分事件时，物品与武器获取提示显示异常的问题
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272019408446.png
修复了使用超宽屏显示器时，过场动画与事件演出中出现的画面异常问题
错误修复与技术优化
修复了使用超宽屏显示器时，战斗过程中生命值条消失的问题
修复了关闭瞄准辅助后，在锁定目标的状态下使用远程武器瞄准时，准星会明显偏向敌人下方的问题
修复了远程武器在特定操作下，右下角界面显示的已装填箭矢类型或弹药数量与实际情况不一致的问题
修复了将远程武器完全升级后，相关成就未能正常解锁的问题
修复了技能重置后，部分成就无法正常解锁的问题
修复了第三章中攻击无法继续命中Boss、导致玩家无法推进流程的问题
修复了特定情况下“剑器收集者”成就无法解锁的问题
修复了第十章中霸主前方出现隐形墙、导致玩家无法继续推进的问题
修复了第十一章中击败Boss后场景变暗、导致游戏流程无法继续推进的问题
优化了Steam成就的验证机制，确保玩家返回标题界面时，系统能够正确验证“使命达成”成就。（Steam）
修复了小库倒地时选择剑技指令，导致指令菜单一直无法关闭的问题
修复了在净化船内部镜头无法移动的问题。与神乐对话后，偶尔会导致游戏流程卡住
修复了无法与地下居住区02外部曲柄互动的问题
修复了在特定时机跳过剧情事件后，背景音乐会一直静音的问题
修复了部分在此前版本中持续处于锁定状态的门无法正常开启的问题
修复了跳过部分剧情后，未探索区域中的宝箱图标会提前显示在地图上的问题
修复了次要探索信息标记重复显示或显示异常的问题
调整了【鹿】霸主变种的攻击判定范围与精准防御判定窗口
修复了装备“双刃剑”灵秘石时，烹饪加成界面与物品获取界面中属性数值显示不一致的问题
修复了在净化船内部使用床铺菜单时，特定操作会导致游戏卡死或陷入无法继续操作状态的问题
修复了ROGAlly上部分事件场景与壁画画面过曝、变成一片白色的问题
优化了SteamDeck上的资源加载控制，减少因渲染延迟导致的背景资源突然出现，以及角色掉出地图边界的问题
提升了整体性能，并优化了多种视觉特效的资源加载
修复了多个区域中的画面异常，包括背景撕裂、阴影闪烁、模型穿插或接缝异常，以及不合理的隐形墙等问题
正如我们在上一轮更新公告中提到的，本次第九次更新标志着游戏定期发布上线后更新的阶段正式结束。
我们谨向所有自游戏发售以来游玩《轮回之兽》、分享反馈、提交错误报告并积极参与社区交流的玩家致以诚挚的感谢。大家的意见对我们不断改进游戏至关重要。感谢大家一直以来的关注、耐心、鼓励与建设性意见。
虽然频繁更新的阶段即将结束，但我们仍会持续关注玩家的声音。如果你有任何想法、反馈或希望向开发团队报告的问题，欢迎直接在此处留言，也可以随时通过Fictions官方支持网站与我们联系。
再次感谢大家对游戏的支持与游玩！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272019301022.png
此外，有玩家发现《轮回之兽》PS5实体版叠加PDD无门槛卷最低已经跌至61元左右。

items.summary: 在《影之刃零》正式发售之前，我对它的态度一直有些忐忑。游戏从刚亮相开始就凭借出色的战斗效果惊艳四座，之后的若干次试玩也都保持着不错的水准。此前，触乐也受邀参加了整个第一章的试玩前瞻。照理说，到了这个程度，我没有理由继续担

content.v: 在《影之刃零》正式发售之前，我对它的态度一直有些忐忑。游戏从刚亮相开始就凭借出色的战斗效果惊艳四座，之后的若干次试玩也都保持着不错的水准。此前，触乐也受邀参加了整个第一章的试玩前瞻。照理说，到了这个程度，我没有理由继续担心游戏的整体质量。
这种忐忑从根本上是源于期待。毕竟在当下，游戏可能“翻车”的地方实在是太多了，虎头蛇尾的例子也太多了。万一《影之刃零》也属于此呢？尤其是在呼声如此高的情况下，一旦有什么不符预期的地方，很容易受到巨大的诟病。
但在提前玩到完整版之后，这些顾虑终于消散了。《影之刃零》不仅达到了我的预期，甚至还带来了不少惊喜。
一个是整部作品“量大管饱”的程度。50多个招式华丽、风格迥异的Boss，面积巨大的单张地图和贯穿整个流程的漫长支线，都让整个游玩过程相当紧凑密集，几乎没有反复跑路的“垃圾时间”。游戏的场景设计也给了玩家很大的观察空间，全程虽然不易迷路，但也需要“动脑子找路”，在弱引导和防迷路之间取得了不错的平衡。
此外，游戏的世界观填充一定程度上找回了最早单机版本的感觉。最新的影视化技术让制作组在叙事上得以进行更多尝试，但这个时而阴冷时而温暖的表里武林世界，即使经历了脱胎换骨，仍然保留着自己的内核。
■ 层次丰富、不断展开的地图
我在游玩《影之刃零》的时候，最常发出的感慨是“怎么还有”，“怎么后面还有”。
这主要指我发现自己在不断地“开新图”。游戏有八张区域地图，但单个区域绝非一个箱庭能够概括，而是若干个小箱庭组合而成，面积相当广大。从每个铃铛、每条岔路出发，都是一次全新的探索体验。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/7566ae008b639265.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
前期其实已经比较明显。比如第一张图“悲泣溪谷”，其实就被划分成了杀气塔、溪谷、谷底上中下三个层次，还有一些隐藏地区。玩家探索的时候，在当下的关卡之内是单线程的，不容易迷路，与此同时又始终注视着位于整张地图中央的标志性建筑杀气塔，始终有一个对主线位置的期待。

但这还是一张相对简单的图。之后，进入陆家村地区，乃至进入庞镇，这类村落和城镇的地图是水平展开的，没有杀气塔那么一目了然，又因为建筑物密集、街巷曲折显得相当复杂。玩家的目标虽然也很明确——比如在陆家村就是寻找并击败三个Boss，但就需要开始自己动脑去记探索方位了。从村口出发，先往左还是先往右，左右又各会延伸到什么地方，在哪里被缺乏道具卡住了……哪怕游戏在地图上都有所标记，但标记得相对简略和抽象，只是起到一个提示作用。在哪里具体遇到了什么，玩家最好自己心里有数，这样才不至于迷失。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/2876ae008b618aa0.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
城市地图更是如此。有些乍看过不去的区域，或者自己跑图时没看到的岔路，其实地图上都画了。一些一看就是死路的地方可能需要后期解锁，或者绕一大圈才能回来，但玩家很可能仍需要经历了一番高强度的“古法读图”。每次感觉卡住，不知道要去的地方怎么绕，对着手绘地图细细比对一下，说不定就知道怎么走了。
而在更加开阔的地带，比如梅谷湖，地图引导基本全靠视觉完成。玩家在开阔的湖面上看到哪里有岛屿和建筑物，直接划船过去大概率就是一张可探索的小关卡，有时候还会迎面撞上一个Boss。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/6046ae008b62d7da.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
和地图的弱引导相对，游戏的任务则是强引导。不仅任务点和NPC位置都是明示，获得了影之武装或者钥匙之类能打开新区域的道具，它也会非常明确地告诉玩家，生怕你漏了哪个地方没有探索。毕竟，重要支线会影响结局，他们显然不希望玩家在信息不充分的情况下作出错误选择；另一方面，大支线背后可能藏着一整张新地图。这件事本身也在游玩过程中刷新着我对游戏体量的认知。
可以说，在探索和指引方面，制作组提供了很多方便，也很尊重玩家的主观能动性。或者用现下流行的话说，尊重玩家的智商。属于“地点我告诉你在哪儿，但怎么去你自己想”。这么一来，我在整个关卡探索部分，基本没有过于无聊或者清单式清图的感觉。
■ 技术与策略并重的战斗与养成
战斗与养成系统是大家最为关心的核心体验。
在 触乐此前撰写的前瞻 中已经说明了正式版战斗的几个特点。除了一眼即知的招式华丽、手感爽快的高速动作之外，在Boss战中死亡可以从当前阶段重新开始，并且一些Boss“风筝”性质的招式，以及特殊的属性攻击，往往需要相应的对策去破解。
体验到完整版之后，从人物成长来看，主人公魂最终可以达到的角色性能是相当吓人的。护符搭配得当的话，在“破局者”难度（普通难度）下，几乎可以实现循环回血。除了被过度群殴或者碰到Boss的秒杀技能，很难死掉。这使得后期图的一些非主线Boss基本上可以通过“苟着”一遍过。
从护符的种类来看，属性增伤、极限丝血增伤的流派应该也是可行的。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/6626ae0095738fad.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而且和之前的“影之刃”系列一样，除了普通药葫芦，魂还可以使用各种各样的药品。这类药品不是消耗品，每次在铃铛处和药葫芦一样可以回满。药品除了可以少量持续回血，还有减伤、减少杀气消耗、增加元素抗性等等作用。在面对主要使用元素攻击，比如雷伤的敌人时，叠加护符和药品能把无法格挡的元素伤害降低至多80%，抗性也增加80%，十分利于战斗。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/8086ae009efc6121.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
但这一切的前提是玩家仔细探图，把护符和药品都集齐并且升级，还要在“人面榕树”处完成连战获取榕树之心。如果探索不足、直通Boss，无法格挡的技能会很难处理，元素伤害也非常之高。在大支线后期，被一支火箭射掉90%的血条是家常便饭，Boss的秒杀技能也会变多。
至于武器方面，《影之刃零》的每一把武器都有非常酷炫的招式和效果，继续升级还会有高级效果。考虑到后期敌人“血牛”的情况不少，又常常遭遇群怪，自带异常状态和增伤Buff的武器总体来说更为吃香。从目前可获取的资源看来，基本每种类型（双持、双手、单手）至少有一把可升到满级，回退后去升级另一把则需要消耗少量逆炼符（10级前回退不消耗）。所以玩家可以比较自由地对武器进行尝试。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/3036ae0091772b38.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
影之武装的情况也类似。面对后期Boss，对策性武装的重要性非常之高。用来破盾的巨斧、用来灭火的龙头、用来麻痹敌人的雷枪等等，在处理敌人的种种高危技能时非常有用。
总体而言，这种对玩家技术和策略并重的设计理念，在保留战斗紧张刺激低容错的同时，对不同类型的玩家群体都更加友好。
另一方面，我也感慨于Boss之多。在之前公开的信息中，游戏有50来个Boss。而游戏的主线其实不算很长，大量的首领战分布在岔路和支线的尽头，要么作为送对策道具的存在——比如先获取有喷水效果的影之武装，能显著降低“舞狮尊主烈焰”的战斗难度；要么是作为世界观的补足——比如“龙柱”的剧情Boss、各路“灭法之法”的幻术师、和过去几位高手的命运等等。
有点意外的是，最初公开的“荒行子”和“七星剑阵”其实都是支线Boss。他们都经过了相当精细的设计，并非是精英怪给了个长血条。哪怕是在“榕树之心”的收集性战斗中，虽然复用了很多Boss，但也会有一些变招，甚至在变成多人战斗的时候一定程度上调整了行为策略，很大程度上避免了那种“用数量充数”的感觉。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/8786ae009175732f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而且，制作组之前透露，他们自主研发了多人Boss的群体行为AI。“七星剑阵”就是一个典型。战斗中的小怪会使出联合招式，并且基本不会一拥而上，避免多人战斗陷入混乱。
大概是想要在不同的战斗中充分发挥这种群体AI的优势，《影之刃零》的多人Boss为数不少。可惜的是，最让我印象深刻、在设计上充分吸取前人长处的主线双人Boss战目前尚且无法透露。它做到了把“一拳一腿”两个敌人的招式作为统一的整体来设计，不仅节奏酣畅漓淋，运镜和视角也拉得相当舒适，仿佛真的是一场旷野上的高手鏖战。玩家们可以在游戏发售后亲自体验。
■ 由人组成的江湖
最后，我想聊聊游戏的剧情和任务设计。
《影之刃零》的主线较为精干，符合之前制作组预估的20小时体量。但正如前文指出的种种探索和成长要素，若非高手，普通玩家很难在初见就一路顺遂地把主线任务做完。
何况，游戏的重要支线体量几乎接近主线，并且拥有两张独立的区域地图，忽略的话体验着实会缺失很多，也会无法了解到故事中涉及势力的幕后故事。而且，这些支线其实有互相交织的部分。直白一点说，就是推进某支线的关键物品需要在另一条支线里找到，缠绕得很紧，如果整体跳过其实是不太容易的。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/7736ae009177d8a8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
游戏的次要任务设计对游玩氛围也是很好的补足。这些小任务散落在地图各处，除了几个友方NPC明确派发的任务之外，绝大多数都是在探索途中偶遇的。它们往往揭示的是乱世中普通人的生活。比如有村民陷入绝境之后把希望寄托于来历不明的“圣母娘娘”，或者有青年渴望出人头地却误入了早已变质的所谓联盟……这些命如草芥的个体在主角到来之前就迎来了自己的终局，但他们的遗物却用各种方式帮助着魂的旅程。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-27/7586ae0098c72b3f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这可能是《影之刃零》虽然含有玄幻元素，但仍然拥有早期古龙式的江湖气的原因。从最早的《雨血》开始，庞镇就是个一直在下雨的地方。魂到达这里的第一句话，就仿佛回溯了这个漫长的时光。而“影之刃”这个拥有表里两个武林的世界也始终是阴冷的：盖世武功无法拯救所有误入歧途的人，所谓正道总是在被过多的代价所扭曲。

回想《影之刃零》这个单机项目从最初立项、被放弃，到再度立项、官宣并受到瞩目的整个过程，它几乎是被所有关心它的玩家看着成长起来的。在频繁的试玩中，我们一开始被富有功夫电影风采的一招一式惊艳，被别出心裁的Boss设计和古今结合的配乐惊艳（是的，正式版中将会听到更多用摇滚和电音形式演绎的中式古典BGM），之后则逐渐认识到了关卡的全貌以及各类NPC的存在。这个世界也在从它的核心与骨架开始，逐步丰满，变得真实可感，成为我们所期待看到的那个江湖。现在，它的样貌没有让我们失望。
■ 结语
当然，游戏也存在少量体验不尽人意的地方。
比如潜在的优化问题。媒体版本在初期出现了一些卡顿、掉帧的状况，不过官方很快发布了更新包，在正式发售后应该会进一步改善。
另外，多人车轮战有些过于频繁。尤其是一些守门Boss本质上是精英怪带着小喽啰，设计显著弱于经过专门打磨、应用了群体AI的主要Boss战，体验是比较混乱且令人沮丧的。反复漂移的锁定很不利于集火单个敌人，但解除锁定后自动追击的招式也往往会追错对象……
某些支线地图还出现了高度雷同的群怪，精英敌人更是纯粹的dps检测器（短时间未将其击杀会进入二阶段）。虽然整体难度不高，但由于山道狭窄，周围又经常出现石头、土坡、树木等场景元素，主角的招式又大都自带位移，很容易被怪堆挤到地形边缘卡住，在高强度探图的时候令人感到有些烦躁。
但这些瑕疵并没有太大影响。《影之刃零》作为灵游坊的第一部大型单机作品，给我的感受仍然是成熟、丰富且充满惊喜的。我能感觉到制作团队在其中倾注的审美、技术与匠心，而且它确实回应了玩家们这么多年的期待，甚至给出了远超期待的实际游玩体验。无论如何，它都会成为新世代的国产单机游戏中浓墨重彩的一笔。

items.title: Dark Messiah's new edition adds co-op, cut content and console-exclusive maps to the 20-year-old orc-kicking extravaganza, and it's coming to Steam this year
items.summary: The Community Edition was created by fans and modders, with support from Ubisoft and Valve.

others.title: Nintendo's New Switch 2 Ad Is As Wholesome As They Come

content.v: Dark Messiah of Might & Magic: Community Edition must be what modders dream about—a big, impactful, community-driven project that enhances a beloved game, with full support from its publisher. It's effectively an official upgrade for the orc-kicking immersive sim, released for free. And it's heading to Steam.
The list of improvements is impressive, and includes:

WiltOS Technologies ported Dark Messiah over to the latest Source engine and worked with the community and other modders to integrate existing mods and fan requests, culminating in this new version. And publisher Ubisoft has apparently been a great help.

"Ubisoft is actually supporting this project directly," the developer noted on the Steam forum . "This would not be possible without them." Indeed, Ubisoft invited them to visit Ubisoft Montreal, where they were able to get the console-exclusive features working on the PC version.

The new edition was announced back in March , but the arrival of the Steam page makes it feel a lot more imminent. It's due in 2026, and there's not much year left, so expect to see it soon. I don't really need an excuse to replay this classic, but this is a good one all the same.
And the launch of the new edition won't be the end.

"We love this game," wiltOS Technologies says on the store page. "We wouldn't be able to bring you the Community Edition if it wasn't for the love and support that we received from the community, so for the first time in the game's history we are inviting the community to develop it alongside us. While we do plan on remaining active in our creation process and communications, even developing new modes and features for people to enjoy, almost every aspect of Dark Messiah: Community Edition has been made to make sure the community who loves this game just as much as we do has the tools to make it theirs."
Instead of being framed as a definitive mod, it's aiming to be a new foundation for a new era of mods, and hopefully it will make the community even more vibrant.

content.v: Oro Interactive于2026年10月27日在Steam推出PC游戏《桌面股神》，首发六折特惠，原价20元，现售价12元，持续一周。本作由Conradical Games开发，所有玩家将在同一个市场中进行股票交易。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793102307_499367_jpg_r.jpg
游戏提供15种以上股票，每只股票都有不同的价格波动特征。玩家既可买入预期上涨的股票，也能在判断价格可能暴跌时做空，通过交易积累资产。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793102313_531303.jpg
市场行情会受到所有参与者的操作影响。一名玩家的大额买单可能迅速推高价格，集中抛售也可能带动市场下跌，持仓结果并非只由预设脚本决定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793102322_594762_jpg_r.jpg
除交易模拟外，《桌面股神》还加入点击和放置玩法，同时支持全屏显示及桌面迷你模式。开发方表示，玩家在工作或观看视频时也可将游戏留在屏幕一角观察行情。

items.title: 《生化维罗妮卡RE》开发异常困难！多次推倒重做
items.summary: 《生化危机：代号维罗妮卡》重制版的开发过程并不顺利

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272006294539.png
卡普空高级执行董事竹内润在近期采访中确认，《生化危机：代号维罗妮卡》重制版的开发过程并不顺利，部分开发工作已经“两到三次”被推倒重启。
竹内润将这一项目描述为“异常困难”，核心原因在于粉丝对原作的感情极为深厚，这让卡普空几乎没有空间去交付一款达不到期望的作品。反复重启反映的是团队“把项目做对”的决心，而非固守错误方向。这一幕在系列历史上并不陌生：《生化危机2 重制版》的团队曾丢弃现有工作、从头开始，《生化危机4》初版也经历过中途换导演的重大转向。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272007492924.png
本作由负责《生化危机4 重制版》的团队操刀，计划于2027年登陆PC、PS5、Xbox Series X|S及Nintendo Switch 2。竹内润强调，重制版的目标是让《代号维罗妮卡》的事件在系列中拥有更重要的地位，而非像原作那样常被视为外传。他还暗示，随着项目推进，各重制版中引入的改动将逐步显现意义，玩家有机会借此发现奥斯威尔·斯宾塞（系列大量冲突的幕后主使）的真实一面。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272007529927.png
此次表态的背景，是卡普空已完成《生化危机》系列的首个十年计划，正步入下一阶段。这一长期规划始于《生化危机2 重制版》的开发时期，主线故事预计将在未来十年内走向结局，而重制版与正传将在叙事上逐步汇合。

items.summary: Get an early look at League of Legends Riftbound's upcoming Radiance expansion.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/riftraidoo-1793060759937.jpg

Riftbound, the League of Legends card game, caps off the year with its latest booster set, Radiance. This marks the fifth set in the TCG, and a highly anticipated collaboration with Riot Games Music. In addition to some fan favorite iterations of Legends, we’re of course introduced to some new mechanics and new Legends, like Evelynn and the IGN-exclusively-revealed Mordekaiser. We’re also getting another two-player constructed starter kit in the form of the Evelynn and Seraphine showdown decks. As a fan of Riot Games Music and groups like K/DA , this set is looking to be an exciting drop not just for players but for a whole different segment within the Riot fanbase.

Arguably, the most exciting addition of every new set are the new mechanics to play around with. In Radiance, we have three new keywords with Deploy, Show Off, and Disarm. Deploy is another take on gear that focuses heavily on battlefield control versus activating abilities at base or equipping attachments directly onto units. For example, the Bushwhack Trap gear allows the owner or ally controlling the associated battlefield to play another hidden card there, even though the limit is usually one per battlefield. Show Off allows players to reveal a card from their hand or choose a friendly card on the field to activate its abilities to a certain degree. The spell Rousing Display may have the player reveal a card of energy cost 7 or more to gain the full effect. If the criteria is successfully met, Rousing Display plays four token units instead of two. And Disarm is probably the most straightforward addition, being the opposite of Assault where units with Disarm lower an enemy’s might on attack rather than empowering their own might. I especially like the new Deploy keyword in gear, as it makes for some inconvenient scenarios for your opponent if you can hold the battlefield. It’s another layer of risk and reward to think about when taking into account the timing of movement. It’s also a nice touch to balance this new type of gear by having the simple act of holding a battlefield to get rid of an opponent’s deployed gear, considering gear removal isn’t as readily available as removal for units. Overall, there’s a nice mix of keywords this time around that I’m enjoying so far.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/26/riftrad1-1793053737184.jpg

As always, the two-player kit of showdown decks is a good way for new players to jump right into the game and showcase the hot new mechanics and Legends. For Radiance, we have the new Evelynn (Body and Chaos) vs Seraphine (Mind and Order) Showdown Decks. After getting a few matches piloting both, the Evelynn deck is probably my favorite of the two, focusing on hiding cards for extra benefits. For example, the Evelynn Agony’s Embrace Legend allows the player to draw a card if a hidden or facedown card is revealed for the first time that turn. This alongside the battlefield, Bandle Scouts’ Academy, which has a player gain a Gold gear token when hiding a card there adds an extra resource edge. Furthermore, the champion unit Evelynn In Control can score an additional point if she holds a battlefield with a facedown card. With the possibility of holding battlefields quickly while gaining extra resources to play hidden cards, this Evelynn deck can really get ahead without falling behind on runes too much. The Seraphine deck is still a contender, though, focusing more on going wide and playing a ton of units for optimizing the effects of their cards. For example, the Seraphine Starry-Eyed Songstress Legend has an ability to exhaust herself and three friendly units to reduce the cost of a spell by two mana or runes. Another cool card in the deck is the champion unit Seraphine Not Alone, who plays a 1 might recruit when she’s played or exhausted via moving or another different ability. In addition she gains +1 might for every other exhausted unit the player controls. So this Seraphine unit can get really buff as long as the exhausted units stay alive on the field. Similarly, the spell card High Note benefits from exhausted units the player controls. When played, the player can give a unit negative might for every exhausted unit they control. It’s great synergy if you can keep these lowly tokens around long enough. For me, the Seraphine deck was just a bit slower to set up than the Evelynn deck. Not to mention the Show Off keyword emphasis in the deck meant having more high energy cost cards in my hand that I wasn’t able to use often enough on curve since I was focusing on going wide. Either way I see the potential in both decks to be tweaked enough for a competitive scene.

Now the biggest question for many players getting into the new competitive season: which new cards should I use in my decks? First off, there are some high-performing meta decks from the last set to consider taking into the Radiance meta. Irelia Blade Dancer is one in particular that’s still a fan favorite with Calm(green) and Chaos(purple). This is a spell heavy deck that focuses on unit survivability while being nimble to gain benefits. To keep with the spells and movement trend, the Satchel Charge card is a good choice to add. In addition to moving a friendly unit, the player can play a bomb token on a battlefield. The bomb token serves as another threat if the opposing player tries to hold. Another good spell card is Hush, which counters expensive cost cards. Sometimes the opposing player just needs a big out, and Hush is a good way to kill that momentum shift. In regards to survivability, the Resplendent Rostrum gear could be a good add, giving not only a +3 might buff to a unit, but also a refresh to your hand and rune count.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/26/riftrad2-1793053952272.jpg

Another current meta deck that could carry over into Radiance is Azir Emperor of the Sands in Calm(green) and Order(yellow). This deck focuses on equipment and Azir’s Sand Soldier tokens. It’s pretty wild to run next to no units in this deck, but it works. Azir’s ability is so unique that it’s tough to stray away from the current deck brews out there. So in terms of Radiance cards, spells would fit best since we don’t have much equipment to work with in these two colors. There are some new spells that synergize with gear, making perfect additions to this deck. The first being Battle Preparations, which gives +2 might to a unit. But if you Show Off a gear card, which is fairly easy in this deck, the player can ready up two runes, thus making this spell free in the end. The other ideal spell to consider is Command: Attack, which allows the player to look at the top 5 cards of the deck and reveal a gear to add to their hand. There’s a secondary ability for gear with the Deploy keyword, but that isn’t the best use in this Azir deck. And Raucous Anthem is another spell with potential that readies the player’s units and gives them +3 might for the turn. It may help with a game-changing big push, including any new Sand Soldier token units that were just played that turn. There are not too many new cards to consider, but the small tweaks can be a net positive.

items.title: Kingdom Come, Lord of the Rings studio Warhorse 'hit by a cyberattack'
items.summary: "This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and for everyone affected."

content.v: Warhorse Studios, the developer behind Kingdom Come: Deliverance and an upcoming RPG set in JRR Tolkien's Middle-earth, has announced it's been targeted in a cyberattack, the results and details of which are yet to come out.

In a post on X, the studio told followers that "We're sorry to share that Warhorse Studios has been hit by a cyberattack. We're working with cybersecurity specialists to secure our systems and understand the full extent of what happened. Thank you for standing with us."
A message from Warhorse Studios: https://t.co/lR4gUOz3b8 October 27, 2026

In a statement to Czech media , studio CEO Martin Frývaldský said (the following is machine-translated) "This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and for everyone affected. Our immediate priority is to secure the systems, determine the full extent of the breach, and take all necessary steps to protect our employees, partners, and our community.
We are deploying all necessary capabilities and resources to address this situation." Though he did not reveal any more details as to what the purpose of the attack was or what its impact has been.
The most obvious target for hackers would be details on Warhorse's two currently announced upcoming games: a Lord of the Rings RPG and a new Kingdom Come adventure.

A successful attack could open up Warhorse to the kind of leaks that have plagued Rockstar in the build-up to GTA 6, as rogues with early builds leak materials left and right, outside the tight confines of studio marketing plans. It could also be the case that hackers are targeting player data, something else entirely, or had no specific plan in mind.
Whatever the case, we'll keep this story updated as more details come out.
